annotations.title: Ask a teammate for a chat

description: Asks the person who holds one conversation, named by id, in the Cosend Inbox to hand it over; reason is an optional note for them. They get a hand-over prompt: when they say yes, or do not answer within 60 seconds, the chat passes to the person this app acts for, and messages can be sent in it; when they say no, it stays theirs. This is the way into a chat someone else holds: every hand-over starts with asking its holder. A chat nobody holds, or one the person this app acts for already holds, is refused, as there is nothing to ask for and a message can be sent there as it is. Asking again while a request waits returns that request. Returns the request: its state (pending until answered), who holds the chat (held_by) and when it passes without an answer (expires_at). Whether it has passed shows in the conversation’s lock (held_by, can_i_send). The request stays inside Cosend, out of the customer’s view.
name: ask_for_conversation
title: Ask a teammate for a chat
